description: This file contains bash shell functions for managing Git repository worktrees, particularly in the context of pull request workflows. It includes functions to determine repository root, manage worktrees for PRs, fetch PR metadata via GitHub CLI, and clean up PR-related worktrees.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Determines and returns the canonical root directory of the repository, resolving from git common directory.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Switches to the specified PR's worktree, creating it if needed, and optionally resets it to main.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Fetches detailed PR metadata from GitHub API in JSON format.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Writes PR metadata JSON to file and exports key information as environment variables.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists all PR-related worktrees in the repository.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Garbage collects (removes) PR worktrees that are merged or closed, optionally in dry-run mode.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a worktree directory name.
